scenarios.title: Three artifact, Saga or legendary permanents give a Storied player an enduring story

setup.notes: Balin, Loremaster is legendary and has Storied. Ornithopter is an artifact creature. Nothing else on the board is an artifact, Saga or legendary permanent.

decisions: A casts Balin, Loremaster, tapping all five Mountains.
Both players pass; Balin resolves and enters the battlefield.
Balin's enters trigger goes on the stack; both players pass; on resolution A chooses to discard their hand (two Mountains).
A draws two cards; the ability then checks whether A has an enduring story.

variants.label: three_qualifying
variants.expected: A has an enduring story. Balin's trigger resolves: A discards two Mountains, draws two Mountains, and Balin deals 2 damage to B (B at 18).

variants.label: two_qualifying
variants.expected: A has no enduring story. Balin's trigger resolves: A discards two Mountains and draws two Mountains; B stays at 20.

variants.label: third_is_plain
variants.delta: The second Ornithopter is replaced by Grizzly Bears, which is not an artifact, Saga or legendary.
variants.expected: A has no enduring story. Balin's trigger resolves: A discards two Mountains and draws two Mountains; B stays at 20.

variants.label: third_is_legendary
variants.delta: The second Ornithopter is replaced by Isamaru, Hound of Konda, a legendary creature.
variants.expected: A has an enduring story. Balin's trigger resolves: A discards two Mountains, draws two Mountains, and Balin deals 2 damage to B (B at 18).

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge reads the designation through Condition$ EnduringStory on the damage sub-ability. Whether the discard prompt (OptionalDecider$ You) can be pre-answered depends on the harness.

scenarios.title: An enduring story lasts for the rest of the game

setup.notes: Balin has Storied. Dwarven Trader is a Dwarf, so it triggers Balin; it is neither an artifact nor legendary.

decisions: A casts Balin, Loremaster, tapping five Mountains.

Base order: both players pass and Balin resolves; Balin's own enters trigger goes on the stack and A declines to discard on resolution; A passes priority with an empty stack and B casts Shatter targeting one Ornithopter, tapping both Mountains; both players pass and Shatter resolves.
A casts Dwarven Trader, tapping the sixth Mountain; both players pass; Dwarven Trader resolves.
Balin's enters trigger for Dwarven Trader goes on the stack; both players pass; on resolution A discards their hand (one Mountain) and draws one card.

variants.label: shatter_after_balin
variants.expected: A has an enduring story from the moment Balin enters. Shatter destroys one Ornithopter. Balin's trigger for Dwarven Trader resolves: A discards one Mountain, draws one Mountain, and Balin deals 1 damage to B (B at 19).

variants.label: shatter_in_response
variants.delta: B casts Shatter on one Ornithopter in response to Balin, while Balin is on the stack, instead of after Balin resolves.
variants.expected: Shatter destroys one Ornithopter before Balin enters; A never has an enduring story. Balin's trigger for Dwarven Trader resolves: A discards one Mountain and draws one Mountain; B stays at 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: B needs priority with an empty stack after A passes in A's main phase; in Forge the harness must hand B priority there.

scenarios.title: Continuous effects are reapplied after the enduring story is gained, before triggers are checked

setup.notes: Bifur's static ability doubles Dwarf triggers only while its controller has an enduring story. Bifur is legendary; with Ornithopter A controls two qualifying permanents before Balin enters.

decisions: A casts Balin, Loremaster, tapping all five Mountains.
Both players pass; Balin resolves and enters, which gives A a third qualifying permanent.
A's Balin triggers are put on the stack; for each instance A declines to discard on resolution.

variants.label: story_gained_on_entry
variants.expected: A gets an enduring story as Balin enters, and Balin's enters trigger triggers twice: two instances are put on the stack.

variants.label: no_story
variants.expected: A has no enduring story. Balin's enters trigger triggers once: one instance is put on the stack.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the doubling as a Panharmonicon-style static with Condition$ EnduringStory; whether the designation is applied before trigger checking on the same state-based pass should be verified.
